summary: Stealth visual effect of a player character (born when an invisibility potion was drunk / spells-3, with RequestStealthVFXPoseOneFrame). The component holds only a pointer to a 0x4D8-byte heap object (registry total 1248 = 8 + 0x4D8); ecl::StealthVFXSystem updates it.

fields.name: Data
fields.evidence: Creator bg3.exe+0x19CD070 allocates 0x4D8 bytes (FUN_1441beb10), constructs a polymorphic object at +0 (FUN_141c73c90: vtable bg3.exe+0x566C6C8, EntityHandle null at +0xD0, second vtable bg3.exe+0x5529DB0 at +0xD8), a second part at +0x130 (FUN_14188a020), sets byte +0x4D0 = 0, then AllocRaw(8) and stores the pointer. Component destructor bg3.exe+0x69FC00.

open_questions: The registry reports 1248 (= 8-byte pointer + 0x4D8 object) while this layout keeps size 8 as instructed; the pointer-stored components already confirmed (ecl.DeathEffectComponent: size 312, class_size 304, storage_size 8) declare the object instead - this one needs the same treatment and a decision on size.
The 0x3A0-byte sub-object at +0x130 (vtable bg3.exe+0x56114B8, constructor bg3.exe+0x188A020) is not identified; its members are not settled.
The first 0x130 bytes need SE's EffectHandler (an external type), which a generated layout may not use.
status_reason: the raw check failed: client: registered size 1248, layout says 8

parts.what: an EffectHandler: built by FUN_141c73c90, the same constructor that builds the 0x130-byte object of ecl::DeathEffectComponent (layout ecl.DeathEffectComponent.json, SE Effect.h EffectHandler): vtable bg3.exe+0x566C6C8, EntityHandle at +0xD0, second vtable at +0xD8

a sub-object built by bg3.exe+0x188A020: vtable bg3.exe+0x56114B8, two null EntityHandles at +0x8/+0x10, two 0x170-byte blocks at +0x28 and +0x1A0 (FUN_1406a3f30), null EntityHandle at +0x348, a callback registered with ecl::EquipmentVisualsSystem (+0x340) and with the replication of eoc::character::EquipmentVisualComponent (+0x350) - a mirror of the character's equipment visuals; class not identified
